title: 第23章 这钱没白花第24章 一步之遥
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
“咔嚓！”
赵寒继续劈，实则是狂刀九式境界提升后，还需要继续劈五十根柴火。
狂刀九式【已简化，不入流，入门050，劈五十根柴】
赵寒有炼皮境打底，劈柴速度极快，不多时便劈够了五十根柴火。
但仍旧没有起身。
狂刀九式【已简化，不入流，熟练0100，劈一百根柴】
“看来今天我和劈柴杠上了！”
“二狗子你继续去拿柴火，有多少拿多少，我的大斧早就饥渴难耐了！”
“啊？好好。”
二狗子傻眼了，这劈柴还能上瘾的不是？我怎么感觉不到呢？
不过话说回来，他是真羡慕炼皮武者，无论怎么劈都不累。
他普通人一枚，劈这么多必然手脚酸痛，甚至脱臼无力。
赵寒剩下的半个下午，就在劈柴中度过。
直到晚上六点左右。
狂刀九式【已简化，不入流，精通01000，在狂风暴雨的呼啸中练十遍刀法】
“狂风呼啸？”
赵寒一愣，这个狂刀九式简化后还挺奇怪，在狂风暴雨中练刀，可是这天气，哪来的狂风，哪来的暴雨。
似乎十天半个月没下过雨了吧。
摇了摇头，赵寒还是准备将重点放到简单且看得到尽头的黑狼拳上。
刚起身，赵寒便感觉自身的实力上涨了一些。

无论是力气、腿脚、表皮都增强或坚韧了一些。
虽说不多，但涨幅还算明显感觉得到。
毕竟才练了三门不入流武功，依然还有进取的可能。
既然没有质量好、层次高的武功。
那我就把数量堆起来，数量一多，有时候也是能比拟质量的。
放在前世蓝星的工厂生产的产品也许不行，质量差就是质量差，残次品就是残次品，别给我找产量多这个借口。
再多，都是通通不达标的残次品，只能廉价处理掉。
但在这个世界，是完全可行的！
因为多练，增幅很明显。
有系统简化这个大外挂，赵寒最不怕就是贪多嚼不烂。
来到饭堂，赵寒在一众老学徒好奇的眼神下排队在末尾，等待打饭。
没有看到梁峰，人家是正式拜师的弟子，估计吃食更好。
打饭的是杂工，舀的饭菜足足三菜一汤，都用小碗装着，用木托盘托着。
主食是四个死面白馒头或者一碗白米饭，自己选。
三菜分别是两荤一素。
韭菜炒蛋算一荤，莴笋炒肉算一荤，炝炒空心菜是一素。
一汤则是白菜豆腐汤。
似乎这个世界的白菜豆腐是标配，到处都能看到。
不过这个世界吃莴笋也太频繁了点，怪不得夜盲症挺严重的，哪怕是炼皮武者也很难避免。
赵寒深深吐槽，不过当吃到莴笋炒肉时，还是给吃光了。

“哎呀吗呀，真香啊！”
厨子的手艺没问题，比起毒蛇帮的那炒大锅菜的厨子强多了。
看到赵寒狼吞虎咽的样子，周围的学徒都是不由露出鄙夷之色。
这新来的像是饿死鬼投胎一样，是三天饿九顿，还是十天半个月没见过荤腥？
content_en:
"Crack!"
Zhao Han continued to chop, but in fact, after improving the realm of the Nine Crazy Sword Styles, he still needed to chop fifty firewood.
Nine Styles of Crazy Sword [Simplified, not popular, entry level 050, chop fifty sticks of firewood]
Zhao Han had a foundation in the Skin Refining Realm and was able to chop firewood very quickly. He chopped fifty pieces of firewood in a short time.
But still didn't get up.
Nine Crazy Sword Styles [Simplified, not popular, proficiency 0100, chop a hundred firewood]
"Looks like I got into trouble with Pichai Gang today!"
"Er Gouzi, go ahead and get firewood. Take as much firewood as you can. My big ax has long been thirsty!"
"Ah? Okay."
Ergouzi was dumbfounded. Isn't it possible to become addicted to splitting firewood? Why can't I feel it?
But having said that, he really envied the skin-refining warrior, who was not tired no matter how hard he chopped.
He is an ordinary person, so his hands and feet will be sore from so many blows, or even dislocated and weak.
Zhao Han spent the remaining half of the afternoon chopping firewood.
until about six o'clock in the evening.
Nine Styles of the Crazy Sword [Simplified, not standard, proficient at 01000, practice the sword skills ten times in the howling of the storm]
"Howling wind?"
Zhao Han was stunned. The Nine Crazy Sword Styles were quite strange after being simplified. He practiced the sword in a violent storm, but in this weather, where did the strong wind come from and where did the heavy rain come from.
It seems like it hasn't rained in ten days and a half.
Shaking his head, Zhao Han was still ready to focus on the simple and end-seen Black Wolf Fist.
As soon as he stood up, Zhao Han felt that his strength had increased a bit.
The strength, legs, and skin have all become stronger or tougher.
Although it's not much, the increase is quite noticeable.
After all, he had only practiced three inferior martial arts, and there was still room for progress.
Since there is no good quality and high level martial arts.
Then I just pile up the quantity. When the quantity is large, sometimes it can compare with the quality.
The products produced in the factory of Blue Star in the previous life may not be good. Poor quality means poor quality, and defective products are defective products. Don't give me the excuse of having too much output.
No matter how much they are, they are all defective products that are not up to standard and can only be disposed of cheaply.
But in this world, it is completely feasible!
Because of more practice, the increase is obvious.
There is a system to simplify this big cheat, and Zhao Han is least afraid of biting off more than he can chew.
Arriving at the canteen, Zhao Han lined up at the end under the curious eyes of the old apprentices, waiting for his meal.
I didn't see Liang Feng. He was a formal disciple, so he probably had better food.
The cook was a handyman, and the food he ladled out was enough for three dishes and one soup, all in small bowls and held on wooden trays.
The staple food is four dead-faced white steamed buns or a bowl of white rice, your choice.
The three dishes are two meat and one vegetarian.
Fried eggs with leeks are considered a meat dish, stir-fried meat with lettuce is considered a meat dish, and stir-fried water spinach is a vegetarian dish.
The first soup is cabbage and tofu soup.
It seems that cabbage and tofu are standard in this world and can be seen everywhere.
However, lettuce is eaten too often in this world. No wonder night blindness is so serious that even a skin-refining warrior can hardly avoid it.
Zhao Han complained deeply, but when he ate the fried meat with lettuce, he still ate it all.
"Oh my, it smells so good!"
The cook's skills are no problem, much better than the cook from the Viper Gang who cooks big pots of food.
Seeing Zhao Han devouring his food, the apprentices around him couldn't help but show contempt.
This newcomer is like the reincarnation of a starving ghost. Did he starve for nine meals in three days, or did he not see any meat in ten and a half months?
